excerpt: An improved value for the lifetime of the (anti-)hypertriton has been obtained using the data sample of Pb-Pb collisions at sqrt(s_NN) = 5.02 TeV collected by the ALICE experiment at the LHC.
title: 3-Lambda-H and 3-Lambdabar-Hbar lifetime measurement in Pb-Pb collisions at sqrt(s_NN) = 5.02 TeV via two-body decay
